name: @workspace/tool-ui-code-format
description: The Code Formatter tool's component and definition (D14, docs/tools/specs/code-format.md): the definition is the main export, the component loads when the tool is opened. Formatting runs in two module workers shipped in this package: Prettier's worker imports only the chosen language's Prettier modules, files of this package, on first use; the XML worker carries saxes and the printer. Records into the tool history through its host.
